metrics.query: cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'brightwater-networks' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-01-07T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-01-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> containers.cna.problemTypes[].descriptions[].cweId (placeholders counted: true)

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'brightwater-networks' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-01-07T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-01-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> containers.cna.affected[].cpes[] + containers.cna.cpeApplicability[].nodes[].cpeMatch[].criteria (well-formed CPE 2.3)

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'brightwater-networks' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-01-07T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-01-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions AND has_wellformed_cna_cpe -> cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('brightwater-networks') = [brightwater]

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'brightwater-networks' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-01-07T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-01-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> cna.cwe usable AND cna.cpe well-formed AND cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('brightwater-networks')

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'brightwater-networks' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-01-07T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-01-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions AND (NOT cna.cwe usable OR NOT cna.cpe well-formed) -> containers.adp[] supplies the missing field
attribution_exclusions WHERE reason = 'DUPLICATE_CONFLICT' AND 'brightwater-networks' IN candidateVendorIds

metrics.query: advisories WHERE vendorId = 'brightwater-networks' AND severity IN (CRITICAL, HIGH) AND publishedAt IN (2024-01-07T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-01-06T12:00:00Z] (one per advisory id) -> cveIds[] EXISTS IN cve_records (state PUBLISHED, datePublished <= asOf)

advisories WHERE vendorId = 'brightwater-networks' AND severity IN (CRITICAL, HIGH) AND publishedAt IN (2024-01-07T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-01-06T12:00:00Z] (one per advisory id) -> max(cve.datePublished) - advisory.publishedAt <= 1 days, compared in milliseconds (methodology parameter timelinessToleranceDays)
